headline: Weathered Expanse Swings Toward Colonials as Callahan's Toll Mounts
war_summary: Since our last edition the seesaw in Weathered Expanse has rolled further toward the Colonials, who now hold seven of its nine strategic posts against a single Warden post and one in ruin, where the previous count found five, two, and two. Forty-one base actions mark the day there, chiefly about Crow's Nest, Frostmarch, and Wightwalk, with firing logged barely an hour before press time and a twenty-four-hour toll near 9,900 Colonial and 10,600 Warden. Callahan's Passage follows close: some 8,200 Colonial and 7,000 Warden casualties, its two-hour pace still climbing, and a Colonial capture set down at Crumbling Post within the past two hours. Mooring County, after thirty-one actions about Gravekeeper's Holdfast, has gone quiet these two hours, as have Palantine Berm and Stlican Shelf; the Wardens retain eleven of twelve and six of seven, the Colonials their five-four Shelf margin. On the Nevish Line the day's levy — above 4,400 Colonial, 3,800 Warden — grows even as the rate cools. It is day 377; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
